Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve. Produce ONE premium cinematic 3D CGI character turnaround sheet, landscape 3:2. Exactly three full-body views of the SAME character side by side: straight FRONT, strict LEFT PROFILE facing left, BACK. Match heights and ground baseline. Complete headwear, feet and all appendages inside generous margins. Neutral warm grey seamless studio backdrop, subtle grounded shadows, no text, no borders, no environment furniture.
Reference 1 closeup is PRIMARY for current facial identity, species, eyes, grooming, material precision and rendering. Reference 2 original is authoritative for full-body proportions, exact costume construction, colors, props and front/profile/back structure, but NOT its linework, paper grain or flat shading. Newly render all details in high-end feature-film CGI with physically based materials, visible fabric weave, raised embroidery, anatomically plausible volume and clean contact shadows. Soft warm key and subtle cool fill, restrained highlights, crisp natural detail across all three figures, no depth of field blur. No redesign, plastic toy, painterly smears, oversharpening or added accessories.
Subject: Ba Zhua, elegant mature FEMALE SPIDER intelligence chief. EXACT nonhuman spider face from closeup: purple-grey facial integument, glossy black multiple eyes with gold rims in same layout, two large expressive lower eyes and smaller forehead eyes, restrained pale mandible contours; NOT human nose/lips/chin, not a human woman mask. Elegant dark brown elaborate updo with pearl chains and gold pearl flower ornaments and earrings. Long purple gold WEB embroidered formal gown, layered shoulder cape, cream/gold inner sleeves, pearl necklaces and shoulder swags, gold belt ornaments, long pleated weighted skirt and subtle train. Preserve large brilliant clear diamond ring on one raised delicate hand as original. Two humanoid arms/hands plus EXACT SIX articulated spider appendages emerging from back, three each side in balanced tiers. Every appendage has clear joints, dark purple polished chitin, fine gold engraved ornament, slender tapering tips, full length visible, no crop, no duplicated extra arms or missing tiers. Front and back clearly show three appendages per side. Side view show three near appendages clearly and far appendages naturally occluded, coherent attachments. Use wider spacing so adjacent figures' limbs do not touch or tangle. Preserve original long slender upright silhouette; gown reaches floor naturally, no invented human legs protruding. Pearl soft luster distinct from brilliant diamond facets, gold thread raised on purple velvet/brocade, articulated chitin clear and richly textured. Sophisticated regal feminine nonhuman beauty, faithful to closeup.
